create_AVideoDataset: create an AVideoDataset instance for audio-video training with kinetics dataset and 30 frames
build_filter_videos: build a filter_videos call to validate video paths and return indices of videos with valid audio and video streams
test_get_video_container: test get_video_container to open a pyav video container with multi-thread decoding enabled
summarize_select_fold_hmdb51: summarize select_fold_hmdb51 to select video indices from HMDB51 test split files for a given fold
review_select_fold_ucf101: review select_fold_ucf101 to select video indices from UCF101 train or test split annotation files
